author: EmuCore - Hub
title: Playstation 2 PCSX2 - LaunchBox Tutorials
summary: LaunchBox’s official tutorial connects PCSX2 to the LaunchBox and Big Box front ends, covering the boundary between a working emulator and a couch-friendly library that can launch PS2 entries consistently.

blocks.text: This tutorial addresses orchestration rather than emulation accuracy. PCSX2 must first run independently, after which LaunchBox is taught which executable, platform association and launch behavior belong to PlayStation 2 entries. Big Box then turns that metadata into a television-oriented presentation. The distinction is important: a front end organizes artwork, navigation and commands, while PCSX2 remains responsible for firmware, game recognition, memory cards and rendering. Links point to both official projects and the LaunchBox support community.

Front-end interfaces and PCSX2 command-line options evolve, so an older click path may not match current releases. The tutorial also includes an optional community startup video whose separate license and installation should be checked before redistribution. Configure and test one lawful personal title in PCSX2 first, then add the front end and verify quoting for paths containing spaces. This recording demonstrates basic integration, not a guarantee for portable drives, multiple emulator builds, per-game command overrides or every Big Box theme.
